runtime_encoding: lossless uint64 PC plus lossless aligned uint64 source address

neural_action_decoder.request_count: unweighted learned Bernoulli hurdle plus conditional Poisson excess; causal per-PC probability-mass scheduling with unbounded nonnegative integer support
neural_action_decoder.targets: free-running autoregressive three-component mixture over direct signed cache-line deltas

captured_stride_actions_role: normal replay and supervised labels only
training_target: captured Stride request count and direct target addresses as supervision only

lstm.architecture: compact single-layer exact-PC-keyed stateful LSTM plus mass-scheduled hurdle/excess count and free-running direct-delta mixture decoder
lstm.pc_state_memory: dynamic exact-PC map with no fixed tracker capacity
lstm.stateful_training: chronological per-PC TBPTT; hidden/cell values cross batches and graph history is detached at batch boundaries
lstm.inference_history: fresh state followed by complete train, guard, and evaluation chronology

parameter_counts: measured and asserted exactly; never thresholded
